claim_boundary: Formal review evidence matrix only. Rows connect each required review artifact to review packets, templates, agents, blockers, and check commands. They do not approve evidence, certify sources, calibrate results, or close final-study gates.
formal_package_claim_boundary: This package checks reviewer-supplied formal decision artifacts. It does not create approvals, invent evidence, or convert scaffold outputs into field-fit findings.
orchestration_claim_boundary: Sub-agent records are review aids. They do not replace formal acceptance artifacts, source-backed reviewer decisions, calibrated validation, or operational routing approval.
review_items: inspect one matrix row per formal target before creating any formal artifact
use the listed review packets and templates as intake aids only
leave formal targets absent or blocked when source-backed evidence is missing
rerun scripts/validate_formal_acceptance_package.py after any formal artifact is added
